title: The 4 Best Blackout Curtains for Bright Bedrooms
h1: The 4 Best Blackout Curtains for Bright Bedrooms
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for blackout curtains for bright bedrooms, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at blackout curtains for bright bedrooms using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Eclipse Palisade Blackout Curtain Panel
products.blurb: Key specs: 52 x 84 inch single panel, grommet top, Thermaback triple-weave blackout backing, Blocks 98% to 99.9% of light.
strengths: Thermaback backing is the most effective light and heat blockerin this list
Noticeably reduces afternoon heat buildup in a west-facing room
Available in dark colorways that maximize both light and heat blocking
limitations: Sold per panel, so a full pair costs roughly double the single-panel price
Stiffer fabric hand-feel than a fabric-only curtain
features: 52 x 84 inch single panel, grommet top
Reduces energy loss through the window

products.name: Lush Decor Insulated Grommet Blackout Curtain Panel Pair
products.blurb: Key specs: 52 x 84 inch pair, 2 panels, Microfiber fabric with built-in insulation, 1.65 inch metal grommets.
strengths: Sold as a pair, useful for a wide bright window that needs full-width coverage
Built-in insulation layer helps with afternoon heat buildup
Darker colorways approach the blocking rate of a laminated panel
limitations: Lighter colors block noticeably less than the darker options
Not quite as effective as a laminated Thermaback backing for peak-sun rooms
features: Blocks approximately 95% to 99% of light in darker colors

products.name: Sun Zero Easton Blackout Grommet Curtain Panel
products.blurb: Key specs: 40 x 63 inch single panel, grommet top, Blocks up to 90% of light, UPF 50+ UV protection.
strengths: Includes explicit UV protection rating, useful for a sun-exposed window
Affordable enough to double up panels for fuller coverage
limitations: 90% blocking is the lowest rate in this list, noticeable in a room with strong direct sun
Best suited to moderate rather than intense all-day direct sun
features: 40 x 63 inch single panel, grommet top

products.name: Exclusive Home Curtains Gates Sateen Blackout Curtain Panel Pair
products.blurb: Key specs: 52 x 63 inch pair, 2 panels, Sateen twill weave with Light Block and Thermax lining, Blocks light and blocks harmful UV rays.
strengths: Thermax lining adds a genuine layer of thermal insulation against radiant heat
Sateen finish looks more polished than a matte utilitarian panel
UV-blocking claim is a specific, testable feature rather than marketing language
limitations: 63-inch length is short for floor-length coverage on standard ceiling heights
Blocks slightly less light than a laminated Thermaback panel in direct comparison
features: Sateen twill weave with Light Block and Thermax lining
Blocks light and blocks harmful UV rays

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
